en.headline: M+ opens Herzog & de Meuron show for museum’s fifth anniversary
en.dek: Models, drawings and material samples from the Swiss firm that designed the West Kowloon building go on view in the Focus Gallery from Saturday until 10 January.
body: M+ will open Herzog & de Meuron: In Focus on Saturday, 12 September, marking the museum’s fifth anniversary with a display of newly donated models, drawings and material samples from the Swiss architecture firm that designed the building.

The exhibition, in the Focus Gallery on level 2, runs until 10 January 2027. M+ said it presents ten key projects in China from 2002 to 2021, among them the M+ building itself (2012–2021), Tai Kwun in Central (2006–2018) and the National Stadium in Beijing (2002–2008), as well as planning studies that treat landscape as a starting point for the shape of cities. The gift is the second phase of a donation to the M+ Collections; the first, in 2023, was a section model of the Beijing stadium.

Objects are shown in replicas of the wooden vitrines used at Kabinett, the firm’s archive in Basel. Senior curator Ikko Yokoyama, head of design and architecture, curated the show with assistant curator Iris Ng. The museum said architecture tours led by volunteer guides would run during the exhibition.

M+ is closed on Mondays. On Tuesdays to Thursdays, Saturdays and Sundays it opens from 10am to 6pm; on Fridays it stays open until 10pm. The museum advises visitors to buy a ticket and book a time slot before arriving. Concession tickets are available for eligible groups.

zh.headline: M+五周年展出Herzog & de Meuron中國項目捐贈
zh.dek: 由設計西九大樓的瑞士事務所捐出的模型、繪圖及物料樣本，周六起於二樓焦點空間展出至明年1月10日。
body: M+將於周六（9月12日）開幕《Herzog & de Meuron：聚焦》，以該瑞士建築事務所向館藏捐贈的模型、繪圖及物料樣本，紀念博物館啟用五周年。M+大樓正是由Herzog & de Meuron設計。
展覽設於二樓焦點空間，展期至2027年1月10日。館方表示，展品涵蓋事務所2002至2021年在中國的十個主要項目，包括M+大樓（2012–2021）、中環大館（2006–2018）及北京國家體育場（2002–2008），以及以地景出發的城市規劃研究。是次為第二階段捐贈；2023年第一批為北京國家體育場的剖面模型。
展品置於仿製自事務所巴塞爾Kabinett檔案庫的木造展示櫃。展覽由設計及建築主策展人橫山郁子策劃，助理策展人吳樂怡協助。館方表示展期內將有義工導賞的建築導覽。
M+逢星期一休館；星期二至四、六及日上午10時至下午6時開放，星期五開放至晚上10時。館方建議參觀前先購票並預約時段，合資格人士可購優惠票。
